import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react"; import "./Loan.css"; function Loan() { /* ===================================================== EMI CALCULATOR ===================================================== */ const [loanAmount, setLoanAmount] = useState(5000000); const [interestRate, setInterestRate] = useState(8.5); const [tenure, setTenure] = useState(20); /* ===================================================== ELIGIBILITY ===================================================== */ const [monthlyIncome, setMonthlyIncome] = useState(100000); const [existingEmi, setExistingEmi] = useState(10000); /* ===================================================== APPLICATION ===================================================== */ const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: "", phone: "", email: "", loanType: "Home Loan", city: "", propertyValue: "", requiredLoan: "", employment: "Salaried", message: "", }); const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false); /* ===================================================== EMI CALCULATION ===================================================== */ const emiData = useMemo(() => { const principal = Number(loanAmount) || 0; const annualRate = Number(interestRate) || 0; const years = Number(tenure) || 0; const months = years * 12; const monthlyRate = annualRate / 12 / 100; if (!principal || !months) { return { emi: 0, totalInterest: 0, totalPayment: 0, }; } let emi = 0; if (monthlyRate === 0) { emi = principal / months; } else { emi = (principal * monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, months)) / (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, months) - 1); } const totalPayment = emi * months; const totalInterest = totalPayment - principal; return { emi, totalInterest, totalPayment, }; }, [loanAmount, interestRate, tenure]); /* ===================================================== ELIGIBILITY CALCULATION ===================================================== */ const eligibilityData = useMemo(() => { const income = Number(monthlyIncome) || 0; const otherEmi = Number(existingEmi) || 0; /* Indicative planning assumption: maximum total EMI = 50% of monthly income. This is NOT a lender approval rule. */ const maxTotalEmi = income * 0.5; const availableEmi = Math.max(maxTotalEmi - otherEmi, 0); const annualRate = Number(interestRate) || 8.5; const monthlyRate = annualRate / 12 / 100; const months = Number(tenure) * 12; let eligibleLoan = 0; if (availableEmi > 0 && months > 0) { if (monthlyRate === 0) { eligibleLoan = availableEmi * months; } else { eligibleLoan = (availableEmi * (Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, months) - 1)) / (monthlyRate * Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, months)); } } return { maxTotalEmi, availableEmi, eligibleLoan, }; }, [monthlyIncome, existingEmi, interestRate, tenure]); /* ===================================================== FORMAT CURRENCY ===================================================== */ const money = (value) => { return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR", maximumFractionDigits: 0, }).format(value || 0); }; /* ===================================================== FORM HANDLER ===================================================== */ const handleChange = (e) => { const { name, value } = e.target; setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, [name]: value, })); }; const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const applications = JSON.parse( localStorage.getItem("rehouse_loan_applications") || "[]" ); applications.push({ ...form, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), }); localStorage.setItem( "rehouse_loan_applications", JSON.stringify(applications) ); setSubmitted(true); setForm({ name: "", phone: "", email: "", loanType: "Home Loan", city: "", propertyValue: "", requiredLoan: "", employment: "Salaried", message: "", }); }; return (
